coverage_notes.result_summary: All 12 targeted searches returned results. No newly verified qualifying U.S. or territorial access-change announcement or concrete service restoration within the window after exclusion of duplicates, historic reporting, proposals, and unrelated material.
coverage_notes.limitations: Recall is not exhaustive, particularly for small rural systems and territories. Search indexing can lag; absence of qualifying results is not evidence no disruptions occurred. Production national collector remains authoritative.
coverage_notes.controls: Exactly one private watch-ledger heartbeat created; no approval, publication, schedule change, or task disabling.
